opening.argument: The material presents a static Lowe’s gift-card promotion, identifying a free benefit and directing viewers to text a keyword to a short code. The title frames the offer as available today only, while the displayed branding and instructions identify the retailer and the required text actions. Although the benefit is unverified, the material contains no payment request, credential request, transaction outcome, or impersonation claim beyond the displayed Lowe’s branding. The evidence therefore supports an ordinary promotional offer centered on a stated reward and a participation instruction, without showing the additional conduct needed to establish a deceptive transaction or resulting loss.

citations.quote: RUN!!!!!! Free gift card for Lowe’s. Today ONLY!!!!!
